Kushner Discusses Hamas Disarmament and Gaza Reconstruction with Netanyahu

US Special Envoy Jared Kushner met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to discuss the disarmament of Hamas and the reconstruction of Gaza. An Israeli official stated that an agreement was reached for an American general to verify Hamas's disarmament. Kushner indicated that Gaza would not be rebuilt until Hamas is disarmed, a position reiterated by a senior Israeli official who told AFP that no redeployment or reconstruction would occur before Hamas's disarmament. Kushner also stated that the US would not restrict Israel's right to defend itself.
